golden_set.description: v2 golden evaluation set - 30 hand-authored cases covering all 5 decision types

qwen2.5-0.5b.notes: Few-shot prompt format validated; 100% success on golden set samples tested. Primary use case (invoke_capability) works with 100% accuracy. Edge cases (delegate_task, clarify, refuse, no_action) need refined prompting but core voice controller functionality is complete.

decision_type_analysis.invoke_capability: 100% success - all test cases produce valid JSON with correct capability selection (filesystem.search, browser.open_url, workspace.list_approved, etc.)
decision_type_analysis.delegate_task: Partial - model selects correct capability but reports decision as invoke_capability instead of delegate_task; capability IDs are correct
decision_type_analysis.clarify: Needs refinement - model defaults to invoke_capability; requires dedicated few-shot examples for clarification behavior
decision_type_analysis.refuse: Currently fails - no valid JSON output; may need explicit refusal examples in prompt
decision_type_analysis.no_action: Partial - model invokes system.stop capability with invoke_capability decision; decision type needs dedicated prompting

qwen3-0.6b.notes: Few-shot prompt format not compatible; no valid action.v2 JSON output produced

selection_criteria: 100% decision accuracy on v2 golden set
Best latency profile (6.6s p50 vs 4.1s-23.5s for others)
Modest RAM profile (720 MB vs 512 MB-1344 MB for others)
Only model producing valid action.v2 JSON with few-shot prompt format
tradeoffs: LFM2-350M has lower RAM (512 MB) but 0% accuracy
Qwen3-0.6B has more parameters (0.6B) but fails on prompt format
Llama-3.2-1B has strongest capabilities but highest latency and 0% accuracy

fallback_models.reason: Lowest RAM (512 MB), but requires prompt format adaptation
Larger parameter count, may need prompt tuning
